Class AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenSeat

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenSeat
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.TokenSeat extends Object
The class TokenSeat is the copy one token estimate reads. The field sequence is the edit number this copy belongs to. The field postedId is the id of the card that edited. The field ordered is the copied card list. The field selected is the copied selected card. The field moodHead is the mood-head string captured with the cards. The field cloud says whether the selected target is a cloud target. The field vacant says whether there was no selected card to copy. The estimate reads these fields. The estimate does not change the live cards. A caller passes the seven values to the constructor. The constructor stores them as given.
